rows.note: Use this specifically for a forecast of the weather.

example.english: Today's weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
example.traditional: 今日天氣預報話聽日會落雨。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use 預測 as the all-purpose noun for an estimate of a future condition.

example.english: The scientists' forecast says housing prices will fall.
example.traditional: 科學家嘅預測話樓價會跌。
example.jyutping: fo1 hok6 gaa1 ge3 jyu6 cak1 waa6 lau4 gaa3 wui5 dit3
